<!-- cli-reference:start — generated by `go run ./tools/sitecli` from the CLI; edit the command's help in the code, not this block -->

Record the review of what a push sends; the pre-push hook confronts it.

```text
Records the review of the commits a push sends, in the file `push_review.file` names
(REVIEWS.md by default), and commits it. With `push_review.required`, the pre-push hook refuses a
commit no review covers, or whose latest review failed; with `push_review.require_judgment`, one
that reaches a judgment gate no verdict answers in the map it pushes.

  anchors push-review --ok "<what was validated, and how>" --by <who> [--note "<observation>"]...
  anchors push-review --fail "<what failed>" --by <who> [--note "<observation>"]...
  anchors push-review verify            what the pre-push hook runs

The range is what the branch has beyond its upstream (or beyond every remote branch), unless
--range <base>..<tip> says otherwise. Commits that change only the reviews' file and the map
owe no review. `anchors guide review` is the ruler for the review itself.
```

## Usage

```bash
anchors push-review [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--by` |  | who reviewed, as you name them (human:ana, agent:<vendor>/<model>) |
| `--fail` |  | the review failed: what failed |
| `--no-commit` |  | write the review without committing it |
| `--note` |  | an observation (repeatable) |
| `--ok` |  | the review passed: what was validated, and how |
| `--range` |  | the commits reviewed, as <base>..<tip> (default: what the branch has beyond its upstream) |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |

## Subcommands

### `anchors push-review verify`

Refuse a push whose commits miss their review or their judgments (the pre-push hook).

#### Usage

```bash
anchors push-review verify [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--range` |  | confront <base>..<tip> instead of the refs on stdin |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |

## Judgment and review — family

Commands of the same family — what tells each apart:

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`anchors judge`](/docs/cli/commands/judge/) | Record an AI's verdict for a judgment gate |
| [`anchors review`](/docs/cli/commands/review/) | Record a review of a target, or list what is to review |
| **`anchors push-review`** | Record the review of what a push sends; the pre-push hook confronts it |
| [`anchors suggest`](/docs/cli/commands/suggest/) | List, apply and decide the proposed fixes |
